svg.aria-label: Docker host SWAGGER-NMS-01 at 192.168.40.5 on a macvlan network, each tool with its own VLAN 40 address. Containers: Wazuh: SIEM: collects logs and agent data, detects threats and checks file integrity.; Splunk Free: Searches, dashboards and reports over the same logs.; LibreNMS: Watches every switch, router and the firewall over SNMP: health, traffic and uptime.; Portainer: Web interface for managing every container on the host.
